title: Personalized Basketball Above Hoop Close Up Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the excitement of the court straight to your bedroom with this custom sports comforter bedding set by Jeminise. Perfect for basketball players and sports fans alike, this bedding set offers a lightweight, cozy feel that is ideal for all seasons. Customize it with your own name and player number to create a truly unique gift or personal bedroom centerpiece.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own Name and Number (up to 2 text inputs) for a personalized sports theme.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly on air dry without heat to maintain its fluffy texture.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features tight, smooth, and compact stitching along the edges with environmental dye techniques to prevent fading.
  • Included Components: Comes as a comforter set with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet cover.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D3
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Compact
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization 2 text inputs
